protocol.action_distribution: pseudorandom uniform left/right/forward via xorshift32 and rejection-to-range3

interpretation: A single pre-generated action sequence is reused unchanged across all maps for each trial; the action policy has no state, image or goal access.
This is a protocol stress test implemented in code, not a model or human evaluation; it is not token-, latency- or compute-matched to model runs.
Solve fractions are conditional on these fixed maps and this stochastic generator. They are not estimates for a representative maze distribution.
Under the current unbounded sequence rule, one planning decision can buy many physical attempts. A high solve fraction at huge action cost does not show spatial understanding.
All model and harness results remain frozen; no planning budget or score has been changed.
